sentinelValues.meaning: Cancel a previous timeout setting and stop monitoring serial port communication.

overloads.semanticRole: SET TIMEOUT specifies how much time a serial port command has to complete.

constraints: seconds is the total time allowed for the affected serial port command to execute, not the time between characters received; on expiry the serial port command is canceled, error -9990 is generated, and OK is set to 0 (catchable with ON ERR CALL).
Only affects RECEIVE PACKET, RECEIVE RECORD, and RECEIVE VARIABLE.
